subject: Clarify: latest SOC 2 Type II PDF provenance and reissue path
messages:
From: Samantha Hill <samantha.hill@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 PDF we received looks dated — need provenance for procurement

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Our procurement and security intake teams found the SOC 2 Type II PDF you previously shared (labelled 2026) but they flagged two issues:

- The PDF's internal metadata shows a creation timestamp of 2026-06-01, which is fine, but the PDF XMP metadata doesn't include an audit package or manifest.
- The file name on our side does not match the sequence number our vendor acquisition system expects (we see an internal reference ACME-SOC2-0001 vs the file's audit_id: RWI-2026-17 in the PDF body).

Before we can move the contract forward we need:
1) The most recent authoritative SOC 2 Type II package (or confirmation that 2026 is still the latest and authoritative).
2) A short provenance statement (chain-of-custody / manifest) that lists the canonical file name, SHA256 checksum, audit firm identifier, and any addendum or reissue reference.

If you already have a bridge letter or reissue addendum that reconciles the IDs, that would speed our intake. Procurement would like this by end of day Monday (PST) to keep the PO moving.

Appreciate the quick help — copying procurement for timeline.

Best,
Samantha Hill
Head of Vendor Risk — Acme Health Systems
security@acmehealth.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Hill <samantha.hill@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 PDF we received looks dated — need provenance for procurement

Samantha,

Thanks for the clear note — we can get that for you. Quick context to avoid confusion: the package you have (redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf) is our complete Type II report for the June 2026 audit window. The audit firm assigned the internal audit_id RWI-2026-17 when they originally packaged it, but our secure artifact store issues an object key for distribution (we can see how those diverge).

Action plan:
- I'll attach a short "provenance manifest" that includes the canonical file name, the SHA256 checksum we compute from our S3 object, the audit firm name, and a note of any subsequent addenda.
- If procurement needs a signed addendum or bridge letter to reconcile the RWI-2026-17 id and the distribution filename, Marissa has a signed addendum (ADD-2027-02) she can attach.
- Soojin can confirm whether we need to perform a reissue via DocuSign (if the customer requires a newly-signed PDF with updated header metadata).

I'll attach the manifest in my next message and copy the DocuSign link if we push a reissue. If you want us to reissue rather than provide the manifest, tell us and we'll initiate the addendum signing today.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Samantha Hill <samantha.hill@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 PDF we received looks dated — need provenance for procurement

Vivek,

Thanks. Procurement reviewed internally — the manifest should resolve most issues but two final asks:  

1) Could you confirm the PDF's SHA256 (we need an exact match to put into our intake system)?
2) If you do provide an addendum (ADD-2027-02), can it include an explicit line that reconciles the audit_id in the original PDF (RWI-2026-17) to the distribution filename and to your S3 object key? Our vendor GRC system requires a clear mapping.

If reissue via DocuSign is faster, we can accept a reissued PDF as long as the addendum references the prior audit identifier — we do not need a brand new audit, just the provenance traceability.

Goal: lock the PO before our fiscal close on Friday.

Best,
Samantha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Hill <samantha.hill@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 PDF we received looks dated — need provenance for procurement

Hi Samantha — forwarding the artifacts Vivek promised.

Attachments included:
- redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf (canonical report we published)
- soc2_chain_of_custody_manifest.txt (contains: canonical_filename=redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf; audit_id=RWI-2026-17; s3_object_key=s3://rw-inference-audit/2026/RWI-2026-17.pdf; sha256=3f8a9b8f2d9c4a1c6d2f4e5b8c9d7e1a2c3b4d5e6f7890a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9; auditor=Grayridge LLP; addendum_id=ADD-2027-02)
- reissue_addendum_ADD-2027-02.pdf (signed addendum from Grayridge LLP; reconciles audit_id and distribution filename; includes signature timestamp and DocuSign envelope id)

A few clarifications in plain language:
- The report in your queue is the authoritative 2026 Type II. There was no material gap or new Type II issued in 2027; instead, Grayridge issued a signed addendum (ADD-2027-02) on 2027-02-18 that reconciles a packaging/label mismatch.
- The manifest above is the canonical provenance for ingestion into vendor systems — it has the SHA256 you requested and the S3 key so an engineer can verify object-level integrity.
- If your intake requires a freshly-signed PDF file where the PDF metadata includes the addendum reference, we can produce a reissued PDF via DocuSign (envelope link: https://app.docusign.com/documents/EXAMPLE-DOC-12345). Otherwise, the manifest + signed addendum should suffice.

Let me know which you prefer and we'll prioritize. If you'd like, we can also provide a short verification script (curl + aws s3 --range check) to help your security team validate the checksum against our S3 object.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132

--
Attachment stubs: redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf (PDF, 2.4 MB); soc2_chain_of_custody_manifest.txt (text); reissue_addendum_ADD-2027-02.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
